_doc: Courtship and marriage rules (Family system). adult_age: minimum age in years to court or marry. courtship: min_favor (favor with the NPC needed to court them), favor_gain (favor per courtship outing), charisma_step (each this many Charisma points above 10 adds +1 favor_gain, below 10 removes 1; minimum gain 1), days (time per outing). proposal: min_favor (needed to propose), max_realm_gap (major realms apart, either way), max_alignment_gap (alignment points apart; righteous and demonic clash), days. concubine_rank: the rank id that a proud NPC (npcs.json 'proud': true) or one of a higher major realm than the proposer refuses. genders: one entry per data/names.json gender: partner_genders (genders this character may court) and ranks (rank id -> {name, max, max_per_realm (optional; extra slots per major realm index of the proposer)}). dual_cultivation: qi_bonus (extra qi fraction for both partners cultivating together, e.g. 0.5 = +50%), realm_step (bonus multiplier per major realm the partner is above you, below lowers it), min_factor/max_factor (clamp of the partner factor = sqrt(partner root multiplier) * (1 + realm_step)^gap), favor_per_month (favor each living spouse gains per month of game time), favor_per_session (favor from cultivating together), max_favor (passive and session favor stop here). eligible_npcs (optional): generated courtship candidates kept in every region at session start and on load (Npcs.ensure_eligible): per_gender (unmarried adult generated NPCs of each data/names.json gender per region), age_min/age_max (years), proud_chance (0-1, chance a spawned NPC is proud and refuses concubinage), realms_by_danger (list indexed by the region danger, clamped to the last entry; each entry is a list of realm ids to pick from).
